blocks.text: Doka coffee tour – Poás Volcano – La Paz Waterfall Gardens

provenance.rationale: Extract the three destinations from the Word days 1–2 heading for this day's itinerary title.

blocks.text:
The trip begins at the Doka coffee plantation.

Here you will learn how Costa Rican coffee is grown, harvested, processed and roasted. Coffee is available to buy on site.

Continue to Poás Volcano National Park. The temperature and vegetation change as you climb towards the volcano. The road passes coffee plantations, flower greenhouses and strawberry farms.

At the Poás crater, you can see sulphur fumaroles and learn about the national park’s ecosystems.

The next stop is La Paz Waterfall Gardens. A trail leads through the forest to the waterfalls. You can also visit the hummingbird gallery, serpentarium, aviary, butterfly garden and frog exhibit.

Return to San José.

**Overnight:** Barceló San Jose Palacio.  
**Meals:** breakfast and lunch.
